detail: Served as a member of the cantonal parliament of Basel-Stadt from 2005 to 2016 (LDP).

election: Election of the President of the Grosser Rat
role_sought: President of the Grosser Rat (2013/2014 term)
detail: Elected President of the Grand Council with 90 of 98 votes, then the youngest Grand Council president in about a century.
Reached second place on the LDP list and became the first substitute (erster Nachrueckender) to the elected MP Christoph Eymann.
Nominated by the LDP on 8 March 2016, elected to the cantonal government in the first round of voting; took office on 8 February 2017 as head of the education department.
Re-elected to the cantonal government for the 2021-2025 term (LDP).

election: By-election (Ersatzwahl) for the Regierungspraesidium, Basel-Stadt - second round
opponent: Mustafa Atici (SP, 3,573 votes); Eric Weber (VA, 1,494 votes)
detail: By-election triggered by Beat Jans's departure from the cantonal government after his election to the Federal Council. Cramer won the presidency in the second round with 37,440 votes (turnout 47.64%).

election: Regierungsrat general elections, Basel-Stadt - first round
detail: Re-elected to the cantonal government in the first round with 28,032 votes (absolute majority 23,189).

election: Regierungspraesidium general elections, Basel-Stadt - first round
opponent: Anina Ineichen (Gruene, 14,439 votes); Eric Weber (VA, 1,436 votes)
detail: Confirmed as government president in the first round with 24,480 votes (absolute majority 22,396; turnout 44.62%).
